types.definition: A Motion to Confirm Arbitration Award is a formal request made to a trial court to recognize and enforce an arbitration decision that has been made by an arbitrator or arbitration panel.

types.label: Sikh Law
types.definition: Sikh Law pertains to the customs, traditions, and guidelines derived from the teachings of the Guru Granth Sahib and the ten Sikh Gurus, though it is not a formalized legal system like some other religious laws.

types.label: L620 Collection (NOS)
types.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily charges on a per custodian or a flat/fixed fee basis.

types.label: Case Assessment, Development, Administration
types.definition: The concept of Case Assessment, Development, Administration refers to the process of evaluating and managing a legal case, including analyzing strategies, investigating and developing facts, coordinating with co-parties, and managing documents and files.

types.label: Engagement Fee Model
types.definition: The model (e.g., hourly, fixed fee, contingency fee) by which legal services are obtained.

types.label: Energy Law Regulatory Objectives
types.definition: Energy Law Regulatory Objectives are the legal and policy goals that guide the regulation, management, and development of energy resources and systems. These objectives aim to ensure energy security, sustainability, economic efficiency, and environmental protection.

types.label: country
types.definition:
"The country of parent.  Use ISO 3166 country code set forth by International Standards Organization (www.iso.org.)
"

types.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Elk County
types.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Elk County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

types.label: Hotels and Public Houses
types.definition: Hotels and Public Houses are a type of real estate asset within the hospitality industry, which provide lodging and/or food and beverage services to the public.

types.label: Domestic Violence
types.definition: Domestic Violence refers to physical, emotional, or sexual abuse that occurs within a domestic relationship, such as between spouses or partners, and is considered a form of criminal assault.

types.label: Relationship-Based Market Segment
types.definition: The relationship-based market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in products and services related to romantic relationships, lifestyle choices, and significant life events. This segment encompasses a wide range of offerings, from dating services to wedding planning, all designed to support and enhance various aspects of personal relationships

types.label: Standard Moroccan Tamazight
types.definition: Standard Moroccan Tamazight is a written or spoken structured system of communication that is a member of the Berber language family and is the official language of Morocco alongside Arabic.

types.label: Pampanga; Kapampangan
types.definition: A language spoken in the Philippines, specifically in the province of Pampanga, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

types.label: U.S. Federal Courts
types.definition: U.S. Federal Courts are a subset of the U.S. Courts and include the U.S. Courts of Appeal, U.S. Federal Courts - Specialty, U.S. Bankruptcy Courts, U.S. Bankruptcy Appellate Panels, U.S. District Courts, and the U.S. Supreme Court.

types.label: Motion to Dismiss Adversary Proceeding
types.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Adversary Proceeding is a formal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to terminate a separate legal action brought against them within the bankruptcy proceedings.

types.label: Stomach Cancer
types.definition: Stomach cancer, also known as gastric cancer, is a type of cancer that develops from the lining of the stomach. It can spread to other parts of the body if not treated and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy.

types.label: EBITDA Bonus Clause
types.definition: A provision in a contract that entitles a party to receive a bonus based on the calculation of earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA).

types.label: Successor Corporation Liable for Predecessor
types.definition: When a new company takes over the assets and liabilities of a previous company, the new company can be held responsible for any legal claims against the previous company.

types.label: Nevada District Court
types.definition: The Nevada District Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Nevada, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdictional boundaries.

types.label: Oregon Workers' Compensation Division
types.definition: The Oregon Workers' Compensation Division is a state agency responsible for administering the workers' compensation system in Oregon.

types.label: X124 Publications/Books/Treatises
types.definition: Costs for any publications, books or treatises Excludes LEXIS, Westlaw or similar online legal research service (X111)

types.label: Plant Patent Registration Document
types.definition: A plant patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a new and distinct variety of a plant for a certain period. It includes detailed information about the plant's unique characteristics, such as its appearance, genetic makeup, and cultivation methods.

types.label: JJ10 Applications relating to originating process or Statement of Case or for default or summary Judgment (UK J-CODE)
types.definition: Includes applications as to service or jurisdiction, to strike out or amend all or part of a claim or Statement of Case, or for the variation of parties.

types.label: TR440 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - Domestic
types.definition: All action associated with completing a quasi-judicial proceeding before an administrative tribunal associated with the Trademark Office of the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under TR300, including Appeals, Oppositions, and other ex-parte and inter-parties proceedings. Includes collecting evidence, preparing and filing motions, briefs, responses, replies, surreplies, and other documents, attending conferences, depositions, hearings, and other proceedings. Does not include requests for supervisory action ("Petitions" in the U.S.) under TR430. Note that governmental fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

types.label: Stipulation to Abandon
types.definition: A Stipulation to Abandon is a legal agreement between parties in which they voluntarily give up or relinquish their rights or interests in a property or legal claim.

types.label: Event Postponed / Rescheduled
types.definition: Event Postponed / Rescheduled: A change in the scheduled date or time of an event.

types.label: Corporate Vice President
types.definition: A Corporate Vice President is an executive officer responsible for leading specific departments or functions within a company and supporting the President or CEO in executing strategic initiatives. The Vice President may oversee operations, sales, finance, or other divisions, often holding a key leadership role within the organization's hierarchy.

types.label: Derivatives Investment Assets
types.definition: Derivatives Investment Assets are financial instruments whose value is derived from an underlying asset, index, or security. Examples include options, futures, and swaps, and these derivatives are often used for hedging risk or for speculative purposes, offering the potential for high returns but also carrying high risk.

types.label: Firm Innovation Personnel
types.definition: Firm innovation personnel are individuals within a law firm or legal organization who are responsible for driving innovation and implementing new technologies or processes. They focus on improving efficiency, enhancing service delivery, and creating new business models to keep the firm competitive in an evolving legal landscape.

types.label: Cloverdale Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California
Automatic Stay
types.definition: An Automatic Stay is a legal concept that arises in the context of bankruptcy and restructuring events, which prohibits creditors from taking certain actions against the debtor or the debtor's property.

types.label: Social Health Insurance (SHI)
types.definition: Social Health Insurance is a healthcare system funded by contributions from employers and employees, rather than general taxation. This model is commonly found in European countries like Germany, and it generally offers a wide range of healthcare services to contributors.

types.label: Cross-Defendant
types.definition: A person against who a cross-claim is brought.

types.label: Civil Assault
types.definition: Civil Assault: A legal claim for damages resulting from intentional conduct that causes a person to fear an imminent harmful or offensive contact.

types.label: Mining and Natural Resources Extraction Industry
types.definition: The Mining and Natural Resources Extraction industry group comprises establishments that extract naturally occurring mineral solids, such as coal and ores; liquid minerals, such as crude petroleum; and gases, such as natural gas. The term mining is used in the broad sense to include quarrying, well operations, beneficiating (e.g., crushing, screening, washing, and flotation), and other preparation customarily performed at the mine site, or as a part of mining activity.

types.label: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County
types.definition: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York that hears civil and criminal cases within Rensselaer County.

types.label: 462 Naturalization Application (PACER NoS)
types.definition: Action seeking review of denial of an application for naturalization [8 U.S.C. § 1447(b)] or alleging failure to make a determination regarding an application for naturalization [8 U.S.C. § 1421(c)].

types.label: Financial Indicators
types.definition: Financial Indicators are quantitative measures that provide insights into the financial performance of a business or investment. Examples include balance, which can help in evaluating an entity's financial health and growth potential.

types.label: Reasonableness
types.definition: The concept of Reasonableness refers to the standard of review used by appellate courts to determine whether a lower court's decision was based on a rational and justifiable interpretation of the law and the facts presented in the case.

types.label: B130 Asset Disposition
types.definition: Sales, abandonment and transaction work related to asset disposition

types.label: Florida County Court - Baker County
types.definition: Florida County Court - Baker County is a specific court within the Florida County Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Baker County, Florida.

types.label: Business of Law
types.definition: Business of Law refers to the management and administration of legal services, including tasks such as client portal management, procurement management, and pricing management, among others.

types.label: Pre-Judgment Interest
types.definition: Pre-Judgment Interest refers to the interest that accrues on a monetary award from the time the cause of action arose until the judgment is entered, and is intended to compensate the plaintiff for the loss of use of the money during that period.

types.label: Use and Permission Tax Payment
types.definition: Use and Permission Tax Payment includes taxes levied for the use of goods or permission to use goods or perform activities. These taxes are distinct from those assessed on the value of the goods themselves and are usually fixed amounts. This category also covers pollution taxes not based on the value of specific goods. Distinguishing between compulsory user charges and license fees considered as taxes and those regarded as non-tax revenues can be challenging.

types.label: Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal with Prejudice
types.definition: A Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal with Prejudice is a legal agreement between parties in a lawsuit where the plaintiff agrees to dismiss the case permanently and cannot bring the same claim again in the future.

types.label: Document Production Event
types.definition: A Document Production Event is a specific type of event within the legal field that involves the creation and collection of documents for a case.

types.label: L634 Exception handling
types.definition: Activities and actions related to exception of both electronic and paper documents requiring special handling. Includes decryption.

types.label: Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause
types.definition: A Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the parties to give their consent to a decision without holding a formal meeting, as long as the consent is given in writing.

types.label: oasis:role
types.definition: A role within the OASIS organization, with subtypes of Editor and Author.

types.label: Missouri Supreme Court
types.definition: The Missouri Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Missouri and serves as the final court of appeals for cases within the state court system.

types.label: Garnishee
types.definition: A person who owes a debt to a judgment debtor, or a person other than the judgment debtor who has property in his possession or custody in which a judgment debtor has an interest. NY CPLR § 105.

types.label: Motions Regarding Litigation Scope
types.definition: A Motion Regarding Litigation Scope is a formal request made to a trial court to determine the boundaries and extent of a legal case, including which issues will be addressed and which parties will be involved.

types.label: E100 Expenses
types.definition: E100 Expenses refer to the costs incurred during litigation that are categorized under the UTBMS Litigation code set, including but not limited to copying, postage, delivery services, expert fees, and travel expenses.

types.label: Petition for Rehearing
types.definition: A Petition for Rehearing is a formal request made to an appellate court to reconsider its decision in a case, typically filed after an unfavorable ruling, and is a type of Appellate Filing.

types.label: Deceptive Use of Credit-Bureau Name
types.definition: The deceptive use of a credit-bureau name refers to the illegal practice of falsely representing oneself as a credit bureau or using a name similar to a credit bureau in order to deceive consumers, which falls under the broader categories of consumer credit and unfair debt collection claims.

types.label: Synthetic Data
types.definition: Synthetic data is data that is artificially generated by a computational process rather than being collected through sensory means or manually created by humans. It is typically produced by a model trained to replicate the characteristics and structure of its original training data, aiming to maintain a similar  distribution.

types.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 9th
types.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 9th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

types.label: Breach of Confidentiality Clause
types.definition: The Breach of Confidentiality Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the disclosure of confidential information to third parties without authorization, and establishes remedies for any unauthorized disclosure.

types.label: JL30 Judgment and post-trial activity (UK J-CODE)
types.definition: Considering draft judgments, preparing and considering any written responses to the court, submissions or skeleton arguments in relation to judgment or consequential orders, preparation for and attendance at hearings when reserved judgments handed down or consequential orders considered, all dealings relating to form of judgment or order.  Includes all meetings and communications relating thereto.

types.label: Required-Report Privilege
types.definition: A privilege that protects from disclosure any reports that are required by law or regulation to be prepared and submitted to a government agency or other authority.

types.label: Attorney-Client Corporate Privilege
types.definition: The Attorney-Client Corporate Privilege is a legal concept that protects confidential communications between a corporation and its attorneys from being disclosed in court proceedings, as long as the communications were made for the purpose of seeking legal advice.

types.label: Minnesota District Court - Mower County
types.definition: Minnesota District Court - Mower County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Mower County, Minnesota.

types.label: Service Canceled
types.definition: The process is canceled.

types.label: Indiana Superior Court - Huntington County
types.definition: A court located in Huntington County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

types.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Bucks County
types.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Bucks County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Bucks County, Pennsylvania.

types.label: X115 Out-of-Town Travel
types.definition: Any airfare, ground transportation (taxi, subway, train), rental car, mileage, parking, and hotel associated with out-of-town travel. Excludes include billable travel time (A112). If client requires a more granular breakdown, law firm or legal vendor should submit separate itemized expense line items.

types.label: Furniture and Home Furnishings Retailers
types.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new furniture and home furnishings.  Establishments in this industry group with fixed point-of-sale locations may operate from showrooms and have substantial areas for the presentation of their products.  Establishments in this industry group may provide incidental services, including interior decorating, product assembly, installation, or repair services.

types.label: Tax on Tax
types.definition: Tax on Tax refers to a tax levied on another tax, resulting in an increased tax liability for the taxpayer.

types.label: Higher Education Degree
types.definition: A Post-secondary Degree Level refers to the education attained after completing high school or its equivalent. This encompasses a range of academic qualifications including associate's degrees, bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, doctoral degrees (e.g., PhD), and professional degrees (e.g., MD, JD), which are awarded by colleges, universities, and professional schools after successful completion of specific courses or programs of study.

types.label: Partner Breaching Duty to Co-Partner
types.definition: When a partner fails to fulfill their legal obligation to another partner in a business entity, resulting in harm or damages, it is considered a breach of duty to co-partner.

types.label: PA730 Assignments and Security Interests
types.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing assignment (i.e. previously registered or filed application) or security interest, including review of file history, checking status and meeting with client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

types.label: Contempt Appeal
types.definition: An appeal made to challenge a decision of contempt of court, which can only be made by a party who has standing and has followed the proper procedural rules.

types.label: Pets Clause
types.definition: A Pets Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the rights and responsibilities of pet ownership within the context of the agreement.

types.label: Event Risk
types.definition: The risk that a specific event will impact the market or a particular industry.

types.label: Georgia District Court - Emanuel County
types.definition: Georgia District Court - Emanuel County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Emanuel County.

types.label: Specialty Court Rules
types.definition: Procedural rules governing specialty courts (e.g., bankruptcy courts, immigration courts)

types.label: Motion to Vacate Default Judgment
types.definition: A Motion to Vacate Default Judgment is a legal request to set aside a court decision made against a party who failed to appear or respond to a lawsuit, based on the grounds of excusable neglect or mistake.

types.label: fax
types.definition:
"The fax number of parent.  
"

types.label: Regulatory Eligibility Determination Service
types.definition: Regulatory Eligibility Determination Legal Service refers to the specialized legal assistance provided by lawyers or legal experts to assess an individual's or entity's eligibility for a specific regulated activity or benefit before formally filing an application. This pre-assessment typically includes a review of relevant laws and regulations, analysis of documentation, and consultation to ensure that the applicant meets the necessary criteria to maximize the chances of approval.

types.label: Consul
types.definition: A consul is a government official who represents their country in a foreign city, often with the aim of assisting and protecting the citizens and interests of their home country. Unlike ambassadors, consuls do not engage in diplomatic negotiations but focus on administrative and practical matters such as issuing visas, aiding in trade relations, and assisting nationals in distress.

types.label: Religious Market Segment
types.definition: The religious market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers based on their religious beliefs and practices. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who follow specific religious faiths, taking into account factors such as religious observances, dietary restrictions, and spiritual needs.

types.label: Limited Partnership Agreement
types.definition: A Limited Partnership Agreement is a legal contract that outlines the terms, conditions, and structure of a limited partnership (LP). It specifies the roles, responsibilities, rights, and obligations of the general and limited partners, as well as details regarding profit distribution, capital contributions, and the management of the partnership.

types.label: Traffic Accident Indicator
types.definition: Y/N - True if an incident involved a traffic accident; false otherwise.

types.label: Discovery Cost-shifting
types.definition: The concept of Discovery Cost-shifting refers to the allocation of expenses related to the process of obtaining evidence in a legal case, where the burden of paying for the discovery is shifted from one party to another.

types.label: X127 Deposition Transcripts
types.definition: Any court reporter and transcript fees associated with the taking of a deposition. Excludes videotape deposition costs (X308).

types.label: National Government Representative
types.definition: A National Government Representative is an elected or appointed official who serves at the highest level of a country's government, typically in the executive or legislative branch. This individual is responsible for making, debating, or executing national laws and policies, representing constituents or the nation as a whole, and participating in governance at the federal level.

types.label: Elem Indian Colony of the Sulphur Bank Rancheria
Base Amount - Expense
types.definition: Base Amount - Expense refers to the fixed fee charged by a lawyer for expenses incurred during the provision of legal services, such as travel expenses or filing fees.

types.label: Peculiar Risk of Harm
altLabels: Ordinarily, one who hires an independent contractor to do work is not liable for the acts or omissions of the independent contractor or its employees. However, if the hirer should recognize that the work is likely to create, during its progress, a peculiar/special risk of bodily harm to others unless special precautions are taken, then the hirer is liable for bodily harm caused to employees for the failure of the independent contractor to exercise reasonable care to take such precautions.
types.definition: Peculiar Risk of Harm refers to the legal principle that if a party hires an independent contractor to perform work that is likely to create a special risk of bodily harm to others, and fails to take necessary precautions, they may be held liable for any resulting harm caused to employees of the contractor.

types.label: Hiri Motu
types.definition: A language spoken in Papua New Guinea, characterized by a simplified grammar and vocabulary, and used in legal matters within that region.

types.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County
types.definition: The New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County is a specific court within the New Mexico Magistrate Court system that has jurisdiction over certain types of cases in Taos County.

types.label: Iron Ore Mining
types.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) developing mine sites, mining, and/or beneficiating (i.e., preparing) iron ores and manganiferous ores valued chiefly for their iron content and/or (2) producing sinter iron ore (except iron ore produced in iron and steel mills) and other iron ore agglomerates.

types.label: Freedom of Religion
types.definition: A freedom of religion claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to freedom of religion has been violated by the government or a government actor. The First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution guarantees that the government shall not establish an official religion (the Establishment Clause) or prohibit the free exercise of religion (the Free Exercise Clause). A freedom of religion claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts religious practices, when a government actor favors one religion over another, or when an individual or group is discriminated against or denied benefits based on their religious beliefs or practices.

types.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Beaver County
types.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Beaver County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

types.label: Senior Citizen
types.definition: A senior citizen, also referred to as an elderly person, is an individual who has reached an age where they are generally considered to be in the later stage of life, often defined as 65 years old or older in many societies. This age group may be eligible for certain benefits like retirement pensions, healthcare coverage, and various social services designed to support their well-being.

types.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Lake County
types.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Lake County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lake County, Oregon.

types.label: Wielding a Weapon
types.definition: Wielding a Weapon refers to the act of carrying, brandishing, or using a weapon in a manner that can cause harm or instill fear in others. This cause of action is typically associated with criminal charges or civil liability resulting from the threat or actual use of a weapon.

types.label: Malware Infection
types.definition: Malware infection refers to a computer system being compromised by malicious software designed to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access. This can include viruses, worms, trojans, and spyware.

types.label: Jury Selection / Voire Dire
types.definition: The concept of Jury Selection/Voire Dire refers to the process of questioning potential jurors to determine their suitability for serving on a jury.

types.label: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute
types.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute is a request made to a court to dismiss a case due to the plaintiff's failure to take action or move the case forward.

types.label: P240 Real and Personal Property
types.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from a real and personal property perspective.

types.label: Counselor-Pupil Privilege
types.definition: A legal privilege that protects confidential communications between a counselor and their pupil from being disclosed without the consent of the pupil.

types.label: Family Law Events
types.definition: Family Law Events are specific types of Transaction Events that pertain to legal actions related to marriage and domestic partnerships, including events such as dissolution and creation.

types.label: Florida County Court - Orange County
types.definition: A court located in Orange County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

types.label: Letter Communication
types.definition: A communication that occurs via physical letter.

types.label: Redeemable Asset
altLabels: A Redeemable Asset is a financial instrument that can be bought back or redeemed by the issuer or the holder under predefined conditions. This option provides flexibility and liquidity to the asset, allowing for its retirement before the maturity date or upon reaching specific terms.

types.label: Otolaryngology Malpractice
types.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a medical professional in the field of otolaryngology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

types.label: PA720 Portfolio Analysis and Management
types.definition: All action associated with reviewing, analyzing, documenting, and managing a portfolio of patents. Includes patent "due diligence" during transactional analysis.

types.label: By Fixed Fee
types.definition: Engagement model where a client pays a predetermined fee — sometimes by milestone (e.g., by document, by stage) or by a bundle of matters (e.g., by portfolio).

types.label: Indiana Superior Court - Morgan County, Superior Court3
types.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with authority over civil and criminal cases.

types.label: Mayan languages
types.definition: Mayan languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in Central America, characterized by complex grammatical structures and a rich cultural heritage.

types.label: Transporting Stolen Property
types.definition: The act of moving or carrying property that has been unlawfully taken from its rightful owner, with the knowledge that it has been stolen.

types.label: Motion to Dismiss Single Debtor
types.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Single Debtor is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to dismiss the case for a single debtor.

types.label: Child
types.definition: A Child is an individual who is the offspring of one or more parents, either biologically or through legal processes like adoption. In legal contexts, a child is often considered a minor and is under the guardianship of their parent(s) or legal guardian(s) until reaching the age of majority.

types.label: Political Vote Privilege
types.definition: The Political Vote Privilege is a legal right or immunity granted to individuals that allows them to cast their vote in political elections without fear of retaliation or discrimination.

types.label: Forfeiture Proceeding
types.definition: A forfeiture proceeding is a legal process in which the government seeks to take possession of property that is believed to have been used in or obtained through criminal activity.

types.label: Breach of Implied-in-Law Contract
types.definition: The Breach of Implied-in-Law Contract refers to a situation where a party fails to fulfill an obligation that is not explicitly stated in a contract, but is implied by law.

types.label: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted
types.definition: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted are out-of-court statements that are admitted into evidence for a purpose other than proving the truth of the content of the statement itself. These statements are not considered hearsay because they are not relied upon for their truthfulness, but rather for another legally relevant purpose.

types.label: Deal Language
types.definition: Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Language refers to a legal provision in mergers and acquisitions contracts that outlines specific circumstances or events that would have a significant negative impact on the value or operations of the target company, and may allow the acquiring party to terminate the agreement or renegotiate the terms.

types.label: Merger
types.definition: The concept of "Merger" refers to a type of M&A deal structure where two or more companies combine into a single entity, with one surviving entity and the others being absorbed.

types.label: Dividend Payment
types.definition: A Dividend Payment is a distribution of a portion of a company's earnings to its shareholders, typically in the form of cash or additional shares. Dividends are usually paid out regularly (e.g., quarterly) and are intended to provide a return on investment to shareholders.

types.label: Public Space Committee
types.definition: A Public Space Committee is an organized group of individuals, often within local government or a relevant agency, that oversees, plans, and makes recommendations for the development, maintenance, and use of public spaces within a community. This committee typically collaborates with urban planners, landscape architects, and community stakeholders to create spaces that serve public needs and enhance community welfare.

types.label: Document Collections by Areas of Law
types.definition: Document Collections by Areas of Law are a type of Transactional Document that group together various legal documents related to specific areas of law, such as Real Estate, Mergers & Acquisitions, and Trusts and Estate Planning.

types.label: L679 Quality assurance and control
types.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

types.label: Cross-Appellant
types.definition: A litigant who makes a cross-appeal.

types.label: Kansas District Court - Allen County
types.definition: Kansas District Court - Allen County refers to a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Allen County.

types.label: Lozi
types.definition: A Bantu language spoken in Zambia and Angola, characterized by its tonal system and use of prefixes and suffixes to indicate tense, mood, and aspect.

types.label: Benign Brain Tumor
types.definition: A benign brain tumor is a non-cancerous growth in the brain that typically does not invade surrounding tissues or spread to other parts of the body. Despite being non-malignant, benign brain tumors can still cause significant health issues due to their location and pressure on surrounding brain structures, leading to symptoms such as headaches, seizures, and neurological deficits.

types.label: X205 Official Fees, Patent and Trademark Opposition Fees, Excluding Prosecution (Application or Post-Issuance) Fees
types.definition: Any fees associated with the opposition of a patent or trademark. Excludes prosecution application (X203) or post-issuance maintenance (X204) fees.

types.label: L612 Legal hold
types.definition: Activities and actions related to a) developing / drafting of appropriate legal hold for nature of litigation and distributing to identified custodians and data stewards, b) tracking and monitoring of responses received from custodians and including addressing any questions, and c) the release of a custodian or data steward from legal hold due to conclusion of litigation via settlement, conclusion of appeal or otherwise.

types.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 4
types.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Delaware County Circuit 4 is a court of general jurisdiction in Delaware County, Indiana, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

types.label: tax_total_detail_expense
types.definition:
"Total taxable amount of expenses attributable to this tx_id, including amounts associated with MATTER_DISC_CRED where disc_cred_category = ""Exp"".

Using the Math Statement on the next tab in this workbook:  
   The total for pre-split expense items for this tx_id
+ The total for post-split expense items for this tx_id  
   tax_total_detail_exp  
  
If tx_id is a Tiered Tax, the value in this field should be 0.

Certain taxes are calculated not only on line items, but also include another tax for these line items -- a ""tax on tax"" situation.  For example, in Canada both Quebec and Prince Edward Island have specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items.  In situations like this, the tax_total_detail_expense figure stated should include the other tax attributable to the line items so that the math statement for total_tax_on_expense is correct.
"

types.label: Price-Based Market Segments
types.definition: Price-based segments refer to divisions of the market that are categorized based on the pricing and affordability of products and services. These segments include luxury, budget, and mass market, each targeting consumers with different levels of purchasing power and preferences for price versus quality.

types.definition: A Motion for Interest on a Judgment is a request made to the court to add interest to a previously awarded judgment, typically to compensate for the delay in payment.

types.label: Latvian
types.definition: A language spoken in Latvia and used in legal matters.

types.label: Motion for Findings of Fact
types.definition: A Motion for Findings of Fact is a formal request made by a party in a trial court asking the judge to make specific factual determinations based on the evidence presented at trial.

types.label: Latin
types.definition: A language that was spoken in ancient Rome and is still used in legal contexts today.

types.label: X114 Local Travel
types.definition: Any ground transportation (taxi, subway), mileage and parking associated with local travel. Excludes billable travel time (A115). If client requires a more granular breakdown, law firm or legal vendor should submit separate itemized expense line items.

types.label: EMS Negligence
types.definition: Negligence by emergency medical services providers, including paramedics and ambulance personnel, in the treatment or transport of patients.

types.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Callaway County
types.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Callaway County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Callaway County, Missouri.

types.label: Treason
types.definition: The act of betraying one's country by levying war against it or by giving aid or comfort to its enemies.

types.label: Tangerines
types.definition: Tangerines are small citrus fruits belonging to the Citrus reticulata species, known for their bright orange color, sweet flavor, and easy-to-peel skin. They are consumed fresh, juiced, or used in culinary dishes, valued for their high vitamin C content and aromatic zest.

types.label: LAW_FIRM_STATEorREGION
types.definition: A geographic location where a law firm is located, as defined by the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

types.label: Sales Commission Due from Principal
types.definition: Sales Commission Due from Principal refers to the legal claim made by an agent or salesperson against their principal for payment of a commission owed for the sale of goods or services.

types.label: Outside Printing Expense
types.definition: Expenses related to printing materials or services that are outsourced to a third-party vendor, rather than being produced in-house.

types.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Livingston County (11th Circuit Court)
By Contingency Fee
types.definition: Engagement fee model where if a matter is successful, the provider is paid a percentage of a client’s recovery.

types.label: Analysis of Pre-Petition Mortgage
types.definition: An Analysis of Pre-Petition Mortgage involves the examination and evaluation of mortgage agreements and related financial transactions that occurred before the filing of a bankruptcy petition. This analysis helps determine the validity, priority, and enforceability of claims against the debtor's property within the bankruptcy proceedings.

types.label: European Call Option Style
types.definition: A European Call Option Style is a type of option contract that can only be exercised for a short, specified period just prior to its expiration, usually on a single day. This restriction contrasts with American-style options, which can be exercised at any time before expiration.

types.label: Condition Precedent Clause
types.definition: A condition precedent clause is a provision in a contract that specifies an event or action that must occur before the parties are obligated to perform their respective duties under the contract.

types.label: tax_tier_max
types.definition:
"The maximum amount of this tax tier expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency.

Use the value ""TOP"" to indicate that the top tier extends to infinity.
"

types.label: Governor
types.definition: A Governor is the chief executive officer of a state, commonwealth, or territory within a federal system of government. This official is typically elected by the populace and is responsible for implementing state laws, managing the state government, and serving as the state's top representative in dealings with other states and the federal government.

types.label: Number of Employees
types.definition: Number of Employees refers to the total count of individuals employed by a business or organization, either on a full-time or part-time basis. This metric is often used for various purposes including business valuation, eligibility for certain benefits or programs, and as an indicator of company size and capacity.

types.label: Breach of Nonsolicitation Agreement
types.definition: A breach of nonsolicitation agreement occurs when a party violates the terms of a contract that prohibits them from soliciting or attempting to solicit the employees, clients, or customers of another party, typically their former employer or business partner. Nonsolicitation agreements are often included in employment contracts, partnership agreements, or business sale agreements to protect a company's relationships with its workforce and clientele.

types.label: Contested Divorce
types.definition: A Contested Divorce is a type of divorce in which the spouses are unable to reach an agreement on key issues such as division of property, child custody, spousal support, or other matters related to the dissolution of their marriage. In a contested divorce, these issues are typically resolved through litigation, with a court making decisions on behalf of the spouses. It often involves a more lengthy and adversarial legal process compared to an uncontested divorce, where the parties agree on the terms of the divorce.

types.label: Contact Name Suffix - III (Third)
types.definition: The suffix "III" stands for "Third" and is used after a person's full name to distinguish them as the third generation to bear that name in their family. Typically, it follows a grandfather, father, and son who all share the same name, and it helps in differentiating among them in formal, legal, or financial documents.

types.label: Management Information Circular
types.definition: A Management Information Circular is a document prepared by a company's management to provide shareholders with material information needed to make informed voting decisions at a shareholders' meeting. It often includes proposals, background information, and recommendations from the board of directors.

types.label: Multifamily Real Estate Asset
types.definition: Real estate properties that include more than one unit for residential inhabitants including residential buildings.

types.label: Lung Transplantation
types.definition: Lung transplantation is a surgical procedure in which one or both diseased lungs are replaced with healthy lungs from a donor. This treatment is typically considered for patients with end-stage lung disease, such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or pulmonary fibrosis, who have not responded to other therapies.

types.label: Equity Committee
types.definition: An Equity Committee represents the interests of equity holders (shareholders) in a bankruptcy or restructuring process. This committee ensures that the rights and priorities of shareholders are considered in negotiations, particularly in scenarios where their investments are at risk of being diluted or wiped out.

types.label: Transportation and Logistics Industry
types.definition: The Transportation and Logistics industry group includes industries providing transportation of passengers and cargo, warehousing and storage for goods, scenic and sightseeing transportation, and support activities related to modes of transportation. Establishments in these industries use transportation equipment or transportation related facilities as a productive asset. The type of equipment depends on the mode of transportation. The modes of transportation are air, rail, water, road, and pipeline.

types.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Lehigh County
types.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lehigh County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Lehigh County.

types.label: Citations to Another Document
types.definition: A document's citations to other documents (e.g., legal authorities, exhibits, other documents).

types.label: Criminal Court Proceeding
types.definition: A criminal lawsuit; all or some part of a cause heard and determined by a criminal court. Any legal step or action taken at the direction of, or by the authority of a court.

types.label: Prostate Cancer
types.definition: Prostate cancer is a type of cancer that develops in the prostate gland, a small gland in men that produces seminal fluid. It can range from slow-growing tumors that may need minimal treatment to aggressive cancers that require surgery, radiation, and hormone therapy.

types.label: Probate Filing
types.definition: A probate filing is a legal document submitted to a court to initiate the process of settling a deceased person's estate.

types.label: BILLING_END_DATE
types.definition: The term BILLING_END_DATE refers to the date on which a billing period ends, as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for legal electronic data exchange.

types.label: Dispositive Motions
types.definition: Dispositive Motions are requests made by a party in a trial court seeking a final resolution of a case or a particular issue, such as a motion for summary judgment or a motion to dismiss.

types.label: A116 Training
types.definition: Training services provided by the law firm or legal vendor and billed as an hourly service. Typically technical or project training associated with eDiscovery.

types.label: Colleges, Universities, and Professional Schools Industry
types.definition: Colleges, universities, and professional schools furnishing academic courses and granting academic degrees. The requirement for admission is at least a high school diploma or equivalent general academic training.

types.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Morgan County (7th Circuit Court)
No Assignment Clause
types.definition: A No Assignment Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from transferring their rights or obligations under the contract to a third party without the consent of the other party.

types.label: X203 Patent and Trademark Prosecution Application Official Fees, Excluding Prosecution Post-Issuance and Opposition Fees
types.definition: Any Patent and Trademark Prosecution official fees paid to governmental and quasi-governmental entities in order to obtain a patent or trademark, including those paid to Patent and Trademark Offices, the World Intellectual Property, Notaries, consulates, and embassies. Excludes post-issuance prosecution (X204) or opposition (X205) fees.

types.label: ADR Court-Annexed Arbitration Forum
types.definition: An ADR Court-Annexed Arbitration Forum is a type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum that is attached to a court and provides a process for resolving disputes outside of the traditional court system.

types.label: M.Eng. (Master of Engineering)
types.definition: An M.Eng. (Master of Engineering) is a postgraduate degree focused on engineering studies, emphasizing technical and applied knowledge. It signifies advanced expertise in engineering principles and practices.

types.label: Medicare Fraud
types.definition: The intentional deception or misrepresentation of information related to Medicare services or claims, with the aim of obtaining unauthorized benefits or payments.

types.label: Florida Circuit Court - Dixie County - 3rd Circuit Court
types.definition: A court located in Dixie County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

types.label: Design Patent Registration Document
types.definition: A design patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a unique visual design of a functional item for a certain period. It includes details about the design's appearance, such as shape, pattern, or ornamentation, and protects against unauthorized copying or imitation.

types.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Fulton County (9th Circuit Court)
New York Court of General Sessions
types.definition: The New York Court of General Sessions is a court within the New York State Courts system that has jurisdiction over criminal cases and some civil cases.

types.label: Regulatory Filing Event
types.definition: A Regulatory Filing Event refers to a specific action or submission made to comply with regulations or requirements set forth by a governing authority. In the context of immigration, it could involve submitting applications, documents, or forms that adhere to the regulations and procedures established by immigration authorities for various immigration-related matters.

types.label: Matter ID
types.definition: Matter ID refers to a unique identifier assigned to a specific legal matter within an engagement for providing legal services. That matter identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) can be created and stored within the systems of various stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts, regulators).

"

types.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within LaGrange County.

types.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Osage County
types.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Osage County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Osage County.

types.label: Expert Opinion
types.definition: A document reflecting a belief or judgment, as provided by an expert on the subject.

types.label: Muslim Religion
types.definition: The Muslim Religion, or Islam, is a monotheistic faith based on the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad as recorded in the Quran. In legal contexts, it often relates to the protection of religious freedoms, the accommodation of Islamic practices such as prayer and fasting, and the recognition of Islamic laws and principles in certain legal systems.

types.label: New York Supreme Court - Rockland County
types.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Rockland County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Rockland County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

types.label: PA330 Design Application Preparation - Domestic
types.definition: All actions associated with completing a design patent (but not utility or utility model) application or design registration application that are to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of invention disclosure materials and prior art, interviews with the inventors, drafting and revision of application, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, and transmittals) filing of application, and reporting to the client. Note that government fees and external drafting expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

types.label: Motion for Appointment of Counsel
types.definition: A Motion for Appointment of Counsel is a formal request made to the court by a defendant or a party in a legal proceeding, asking the court to appoint an attorney to represent them in the case.

types.label: Cucumbers
types.definition: Cucumbers are elongated, green fruit vegetables from the Cucumis sativus species, known for their crisp texture and refreshing taste. They are commonly consumed raw in salads, pickled, or used as a garnish, and are valued for their hydrating properties and low calorie content.

types.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Washington County
types.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Washington County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

types.label: Local
types.definition: Actor attribute designating locality (e.g., local counsel, local expert, local business contact).

types.label: X103 Copy Service (External)
types.definition: Any black & white or color copy, binding and reassembly charges when that service is performed by an external party and paid by the law firm or legal vendor

types.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 11 Case
types.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 11 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed bankruptcy case under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code.

types.label: Indiana Circuit Court - White County
types.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - White County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within White County.

types.label: Environmental Review Claim
types.definition: An Environmental Review Claim is a legal action asserting that a project or action has not adequately complied with environmental impact assessment requirements mandated by law. Such claims typically allege insufficient analysis of potential environmental effects, failure to consider alternatives, or inadequate mitigation measures for identified impacts.

types.label: Claim for Falling on Commercial Sidewalk
types.definition: A claim for falling on a commercial sidewalk is a legal action brought by an individual who has suffered injuries due to a slip-and-fall accident caused by the negligence of a commercial property owner.

types.label: Misdemeanor Manslaughter
types.definition: Misdemeanor Manslaughter is a type of negligent manslaughter that occurs when a person commits a misdemeanor offense that results in the death of another person.

types.label: Middle Eastern / North African
types.definition: Middle Eastern / North African (MENA) is an ethnicity that refers to individuals who originate from or have ancestry in the regions of the Middle East and North Africa, which encompass countries such as Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Lebanon, Morocco, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey, among others. This diverse group of people shares historical, cultural, linguistic, and religious ties, while also exhibiting distinct differences across the various nations and communities.

types.definition: Multi party communication whether by telephone, video or external

types.label: Winner-Take-All - Multi-Winner System
types.definition: A winner-take-all multi-winner system is an electoral method where multiple candidates are elected from a single district, and the candidates with the highest number of votes win the available seats. This system can lead to one party or group dominating the representation, often marginalizing minority party voters.

types.label: Probate Reason of Substance Abuse
types.definition: Probate Reason of Substance Abuse refers to the legal grounds for filing a subsequent probate case due to the decedent's substance abuse issues.

types.label: PA710 Opinion Preparation
types.definition: All action associated with the completing formal legal opinions on the validity, enforceability, infringement, and/or non-infringement of a patent claim. Includes opinions on infringement of a client's patent by a non-client infringer.

types.label: European Union
types.definition: The European Union (EU) Government is a permanent or semi-permanent administrative entity of the European Union that oversees and administers specific governmental functions within the EU.

types.label: Customer Lifetime Value
types.definition: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) is a metric that represents the total net profit a company expects to earn from a customer throughout their entire relationship. It is calculated by multiplying the average value of a customer transaction by the number of repeat transactions and the average retention time in a specific period.

types.label: Inuktitut
types.definition: A language spoken by the Inuit people in Canada and parts of Greenland, characterized by a complex system of inflection and agglutination.

types.label: Sign On Bonus Clause
types.definition: A sign-on bonus clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a bonus payment made to an employee upon joining a company.

types.label: Anti-Bribery Clause
types.definition: An Anti-Bribery Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting of any form of bribe or kickback in connection with the performance of the contract.

types.label: M&A Practice Components
types.definition: M&A Practice Components refers to the specific tasks and activities involved in the process of mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, drafting and negotiating agreements, regulatory compliance, financing, and post-closing matters.

types.label: X402 Transaction Fee
types.definition: Delivery of information on a transaction basis as opposed to a per user license fee or a subscription fee. Indicate # of transactions as units; if pricing varies by transaction, split into multiple expense lines by rate.

types.label: Minnesota District Court - Pipestone County
types.definition: Minnesota District Court - Pipestone County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pipestone County.

types.label: Legal System Types
types.definition: Legal System Types refer to the various frameworks of laws, rules, and institutions that govern the legal processes and procedures within a jurisdiction. These systems encompass distinct traditions, principles, and methodologies that have evolved over time, influenced by cultural, religious, and historical factors.

types.label: Permanent Resident
types.definition: A Permanent Resident is an individual who has been granted the right to live indefinitely within a country, typically after meeting certain eligibility criteria. In the United States, for example, this status is commonly referred to as having a "Green Card," and it grants the holder various rights and responsibilities, including the ability to work and reside in the country long-term, but does not confer citizenship.

types.label: Immigration Law
types.definition: National statutes, and regulations governing immigration into and deportation from a country including issues of naturalization and citizenship.

types.label: Marathi
types.definition: Marathi is a structured system of communication, consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, which is a subcategory of the Language class.

types.label: Privacy Agreements
types.definition: A Privacy Related Agreement refers to a contract or clause that stipulates how personal data will be processed, protected, and maintained. It underscores the obligations of parties in relation to data privacy and compliance with privacy laws and regulations.

types.label: Fact Investigation and Development
types.definition: Fact Investigation and Development refers to the process of gathering and analyzing evidence and information related to a legal matter, including interviewing witnesses and experts, analyzing technical data, and assessing the validity of claims.

types.label: Copyright Assets
types.definition: Copyright assets are a type of intellectual property asset that refers to the exclusive legal right to use and distribute original works of authorship, such as books, music, and software.

types.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1
types.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.

types.label: Leading Objection
types.definition: An objection to a leading question is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question posed by the opposing counsel improperly suggests an answer to the witness. Leading questions are generally not allowed during direct examination but may be permitted during cross-examination.

types.label: Military Active Duty
types.definition: "Military Active Duty" refers to a period during which individuals in the armed forces are in full-time service, actively engaged in their duties, and can be deployed at any time. This status contrasts with reserve or part-time duties and involves more direct involvement in military operations.

types.label: Affirmative Covenant
types.definition: An affirmative covenant is a legally binding promise made by one party to another to take specific actions or refrain from certain activities, as outlined in a contract or agreement, in order to fulfill a particular obligation or achieve a specific goal.

types.label: Indemnification from Person Ordering Tort
types.definition: Indemnification from Person Ordering Tort: A legal concept that refers to the compensation or protection provided to a party who is held liable for a tortious act, but is entitled to be reimbursed by the person who ordered or directed the act.

types.label: General Discharge Under Honorable Conditions
types.definition: Often referred to simply as a General Discharge, this type indicates satisfactory service but the individual fell short of meeting all expectations.

types.label: Analysis of Cash Management
types.definition: Analysis of Cash Management: A process of examining and evaluating the flow and use of cash within an organization, including the identification of areas for improvement and the development of strategies to optimize cash management.

types.label: Georgia District Court - Worth County
types.definition: Georgia District Court - Worth County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Worth County.

types.label: Law Codified by Statute
types.definition: Law Codified by Statute refers to legal rules and regulations that have been enacted by a legislative body and are binding and enforceable.

types.label: Failure to Exhaust Administrative Remedy
types.definition: The Failure to Exhaust Administrative Remedy is a legal defense in civil litigation where the plaintiff has not completed all required administrative procedures before filing a lawsuit.

types.label: Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit
types.definition: An Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit is an insurance claim concept that refers to the situation where an insurance company provides legal defense to its policyholder in a lawsuit.

types.label: War Clause Claim
types.definition: A War Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular action or law exceeds the constitutional authority granted to the government in times of war. This claim is based on the interpretation that the War Clause, which grants Congress the power to declare war, also imposes limitations on the government's actions during war, such as the exercise of certain powers or the infringement of individual rights.

types.label: Debt Agreement
types.definition: A Debt Agreement is a legally binding contract between a debtor and creditor(s) that outlines the terms and conditions for repayment of a debt, including any interest or fees.

types.label: Successor in Interest Petition
types.definition: The I-140 Successor in Interest Petition is a process in the United States through which a new employer or entity assumes the sponsorship of an employment-based immigrant visa (green card) petition that was previously filed by a predecessor employer. This is relevant when the original petitioner goes out of business or undergoes a merger, acquisition, or other organizational change. The new employer or entity can file a Successor in Interest Petition to continue the green card process for the beneficiary (foreign worker) without starting the process anew, provided certain conditions are met.

types.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Clinton County (4th Circuit Court)
B410 General Bankruptcy Advice/Opinions
types.definition: Analysis, advice and/or opinions regarding potential bankruptcy related issues, where no bankruptcy case has been filed

types.label: Population Density Market Segment
types.definition: The population density market segment classifies consumers or businesses based on the density of people in their geographic area, such as urban, rural, or suburban regions. This segmentation helps businesses understand and address the varying needs, preferences, and purchasing behaviors of customers living in areas with different levels of population concentration.

types.label: B140 Relief from Stay/Adequate Protection Proceedings
types.definition: Matters relating to termination or continuation of automatic stay under 362 and motions for adequate protection

types.label: Visa for Free Trade Agreement Professionals
types.definition: A Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Professionals Visa is a type of visa that allows citizens of countries that have signed a free trade agreement with a particular country to work in that country under specific conditions. These visas often facilitate the movement of professionals such as businesspeople, traders, and certain skilled workers, aiming to promote economic cooperation and trade between the countries.

types.label: Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product
types.definition: The concept of "Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product" refers to a defense in product liability cases where the defendant argues that the plaintiff's injury was caused by using the product in a way that was not intended or foreseeable by the manufacturer.

types.label: Vaccine Negligence
types.definition: Failure to provide proper care or attention in administering vaccines, resulting in harm or injury to the patient, and the legal claims that arise from such negligence.

types.label: Status - Denied
types.definition: Status of "Denied" indicates that an application, request, or action has been reviewed and declined by the relevant authority, signaling that the individual's request or application did not meet the necessary criteria or legal requirements, resulting in a denial of the intended action, status change, or benefit.

types.label: Request for Budget
types.definition: Document where a Buyer asks a Legal Services Provider for a budget.

types.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 12 Claim
types.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 12 Claim is a type of claim made in a bankruptcy case filed under Chapter 12 of the Bankruptcy Code, which provides relief to family farmers or fishermen.

types.label: Service of Document
types.definition: The concept of "Service of Document" refers to the act of delivering legal documents to the parties involved in a litigation event.

types.label: B185 Assumption/Rejection of Leases and Contracts
types.definition: Analysis of leases and executory contracts and preparation of motions specifically to assume or reject

types.label: Tax Form
types.definition: A Tax Form is a standardized document used to report financial information to taxation authorities. It is the primary means for individuals and organizations to file tax returns, claim deductions, and comply with tax laws.

types.label: Indemnification Provisions Clause
types.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any losses or damages incurred as a result of the contract, typically related to legal claims or liabilities.

types.label: By Time with Blended Rate
types.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays for the legal service provider's number of expended hours, but rather than paying for a person's individualized rate (e.g., partner's higher rate, associate's lower rate), the provider pays an average billable rate — regardless of which lawyer performs the work.

types.label: disc_cred

EIA - Expense Item Adjustment - A flat adjustment (reduction or credit) applied to the fee item

EIDHR - Expense Item Discounted Hourly Rate - the discounted hourly rate or unit rate applied to the expense item
EIFF - Expense Item is billed at a Flat Fee
Other - Any other type of discount of credit applied to the line item
"

types.label: Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor
types.definition: The concept of "Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor" refers to the situation where someone exerts pressure or control over a person creating a trust or will, causing them to make decisions that they would not have made otherwise.

types.label: Robust AI
types.definition: Robust AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that are both technically and socially resilient, designed to prevent unintentional harm. Technically robust AI systems are built to handle diverse conditions and adversarial attacks, while socially robust AI systems are designed to function ethically within societal contexts, ensuring safety, reliability, and fairness.

types.label: Health Insurance Benefits
types.definition: Health insurance benefits refer to any medical coverage provided to employees as part of their compensation package, which pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured, often including preventive care and prescription medication.

types.label: Budgeting Management
types.definition: Budgeting Management refers to the process of planning and controlling the financial resources of a business or organization within the legal industry.

types.label: Intervening Event - Known at Signing
types.definition: An Intervening Event - Known at Signing is a specific type of event that occurs after the signing of a legal agreement and has been anticipated by the parties involved.

types.label: Collaboration Platform Management
types.definition: Collaboration Platform Management refers to the management of a system or software that enables individuals or groups to work together on a project or task, including the coordination of communication, data sharing, and workflow.

Cornish
types.definition: Cornish (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

types.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal
types.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal is a request made to a court to pause legal proceedings until an appeal is resolved.

types.label: Arkansas District Court - Garland Cty.
types.definition: A court located in Garland County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

types.definition: All actions associated with the preparation and filing of applications for validation of an issued regional patent outside of the ('domestic') home country of the applicant. Note that PCT National Phase Entry is a continuing application process included under PA350 or PA550.

types.label: Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure
types.definition: U.S. federal courts' body of procedural rules governing appeals.

types.label: Three-fifths Clause Claim
types.definition: A Three-fifths Clause claim is a legal assertion tied to Article I, Section 2, Clause 3 of the U.S. Constitution, historically known as the Three-fifths Clause. This clause counted enslaved individuals as three-fifths of a person for purposes of representation and taxation, but it was effectively rendered obsolete by the Thirteenth Amendment, which abolished slavery.

types.label: Key Employee Incentive Program Motion
types.definition: A Key Employee Incentive Program Motion (KEIP) is a request made in a bankruptcy case to provide incentives to key employees to remain with the company during the bankruptcy process.

types.label: Threatened Battery Assault
types.definition: The concept of Threatened Battery Assault refers to a criminal assault where the perpetrator intentionally causes the victim to fear immediate bodily harm or offensive contact, without actually making physical contact.

types.label: Indiana Superior Court - Porter County
types.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Porter County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Porter County, Indiana.

types.label: Ohio Court of Common Pleas
types.definition: The Ohio Court of Common Pleas is a specific court within the Ohio State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases at the county level.

types.label: Common Carrier Liability
types.definition: Common Carrier Liability refers to the legal responsibility of transportation companies, such as railroads, trucking companies, and cruise ships, to ensure the safety of their passengers and cargo while in transit.

types.label: Tax Payment Event
types.definition: A tax payment event refers to the specific occasion when an individual or entity remits payment to a tax authority to settle or reduce a tax liability.

types.label: Docketing Management
types.definition: Docketing Management refers to the process of managing and tracking legal cases and their associated deadlines and events. It falls under the broader category of Litigation Management, which encompasses all aspects of managing a legal case from start to finish.

types.label: Private-run Pension Account
types.definition: A private-run pension account is a retirement savings account managed by a private financial institution, such as a bank or investment firm. These accounts are typically funded by individual contributions and can offer various investment options.

types.label: Confectionery Merchant Wholesalers

types.label: Arbitration Clause
types.definition: An arbitration clause is a provision in a contract that requires any disputes arising from the contract to be resolved through arbitration rather than through the court system.

types.label: Equitable Claims
types.definition: A claim that seeks fairness and justice, rather than a legal remedy, and is based on principles of equity and conscience.

types.label: X403 Hardware Costs
types.definition: Any hardware purchased, including cell phones/PDAs/Blackberries; desktops/laptops/tablets; DVD/CD Drives; external hard drives; servers; USB drives or future technology hardware device. Excludes material costs for electronic media devices used to move a data collection in eDiscovery (X307).

types.label: Indiana Superior Court - Putnam County
types.definition: A court located in Putnam County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

types.label: Drafting Drafting Notes
types.definition: Drafting Notes are annotations made by writers and editors during the document drafting process. These notes often include comments, suggestions, and explanations to aid in the development and refinement of the document.

types.label: Chronic Soft Tissue Surgical Intervention
types.definition: A soft tissue injury or abnormality under continuing surgical management involves damage or dysfunction affecting non-bone structures such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, or skin that requires ongoing surgical intervention. This management is aimed at repairing or reconstructing the damaged soft tissues and addressing any related complications or functional impairments.

types.label: Double Trigger Acceleration Clause
types.definition: A Double Trigger Acceleration Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the acceleration of vesting or payment of compensation upon the occurrence of two specified events, such as a change in control of a company and termination of employment.

types.label: PA540 Plant Patent Preparation - International
types.definition: All actions associated with completing plant patent applications that are to be filed outside the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, including translations, review of any invention disclosure materials or parent applications, drafting of application including pre-filing revision of parent applications, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, transmittals, and biological deposits) filing of application, and reporting to the client Note that government fees and other external expenses are included under E100.

types.label: Avoidance Action Practice
types.definition: Avoidance Action Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice area, which involves pursuing actions to recover assets or payments made by a debtor prior to filing for bankruptcy.

types.label: Motion to Postpone Settlement Conference
types.definition: A Motion to Postpone Settlement Conference is a request made by one party in a legal case to delay the scheduled settlement conference to a later date.

types.label: Florida Circuit Court - Collier County - 20th Circuit Court
types.definition: A court located in Collier County, Florida that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

types.label: Disclosure Letter Clause
types.definition: A Disclosure Letter Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires one party to provide the other party with a letter disclosing certain information related to the contract.

types.label: Medical Expert
types.definition: A person who holds a health care professional degree from a university or college, who has engaged in the practice of that profession, and who has knowledge or skill about the subject upon which he is called to testify or provide an opinion. See Fla. Stat. § 766.202(5); Fort Walton Beach Medical Center, Inc. v. Dingler, 697 So.2d 575 (Fla. App. 1997).

types.label: Church Slavic; Old Slavonic; Church Slavonic; Old Bulgarian; Old Church Slavonic
